sloka: तस्य तत्कर्म विज्ञाय तदा वैश्रवणात्मजः ।मुहूर्तात्क्रोधताम्राक्षस्तोयं जग्राह पाणिना ।। ७.२६.५४ ॥
transliteration: tasya tatkarma vijñāya tadā vaiśravaṇātmajaḥ ।muhūrtātkrodhatāmrākṣastoyaṁ jagrāha pāṇinā ।। 7.26.54 ॥

translations.english: Having understood that deed of his, the son of Vaishravana (Kubera) instantly, with eyes red from anger, took water in his hand.
